input.quote: 5.2 The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property ownership provision. HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site and holds the Company's Content, user information and data (p0048), yet nothing states who owns the Site, the deliverables the Company funds, the Content it supplies or the customer data collected through the Site, and there is no licence back of HDI platform IP embedded in the Site. The closest provisions are editorial control (5.2), merchant-of-record/title to goods (5.3), the limited trademark licence with no implied licences (6.1) and the confidentiality obligations (8) — none of which is an ownership or assignment clause. On the positive side, nothing assigns Company IP or data to HDI and no joint ownership is created (10.2 expressly disclaims co-ownership), so this is a gap rather than walk-away territory. We added a Section 5.5 reaching the preferred position: Company ownership of the Site, deliverables and customer data with an HDI assignment, HDI retention of its pre-existing software and tools, and a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any HDI materials embedded in the Site.

proposal.summary: Add a Section 5.5 ownership clause: Company owns the Site, deliverables and customer data; HDI retains background IP and grants a perpetual licence back; no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership provision, so we have added one confirming that we own the Site, the Content and the customer data generated through it, consistent with our playbook that we own what we pay for and everything we put in. HDI keeps its pre-existing platform and tools and grants us a perpetual, royalty-free licence to anything of its own embedded in the Site.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to the Site (including the Content and the design and look and feel of the Site), all deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement, and all customer data and user information collected through the Site, and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all such right, title and interest. HDI shall retain all right, title and interest in and to its pre-existing software, systems, tools and know-how, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any such HDI materials incorporated into the Site or any deliverable for the Company's business purposes. Nothing in this Agreement shall create any joint ownership of intellectual property or operate as an assignment to HDI of any of the Company's intellectual property, Content or customer data.
